lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx on Omarchy

32-bit OpenCL support for NVIDIA GPUs on the 580-series driver.

Package data synced 2026-10-28 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx. It is a 2.8 MB download (23 MB installed), version 580.178.04-1.1, licensed custom. OpenCL implemention for NVIDIA (32-bit) (580xx). Free to use (proprietary driver component, free to download and use, not open source).

Install lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx on Omarchy

This package installs NVIDIA's 32-bit OpenCL implementation for the 580xx proprietary driver branch, allowing 32-bit applications to run GPU-accelerated compute (OpenCL) workloads on an NVIDIA card. Like other lib32 packages it is purely a runtime library with no interface of its own, used by other software rather than run directly by a user.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 580.178.04-1.1:
    pacman -Qi lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx

Open and use lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx

lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx | grep /usr/bin/

lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx requirements and compatibility

  • a supported NVIDIA GPU (matching the 580xx branch's supported architectures)
  • the matching nvidia-580xx driver installed
  • an OpenCL-using 32-bit application to actually invoke it

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • lib32-zlib
  • lib32-gcc-libs

Pricing and license

Free to use (proprietary driver component, free to download and use, not open source). License: custom.

Uninstall lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx

omarchy pkg drop lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx

Frequently asked questions

How do I install lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx. The download is 2.8 MB and it takes 23 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx free?

Free to use (proprietary driver component, free to download and use, not open source). The package is licensed custom.

How do I uninstall lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx?

Run omarchy pkg drop lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx. It removes the package from your system.

What does lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: lib32-zlib, lib32-gcc-libs. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx a desktop app?

No. lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as lib32-opencl-nvidia-580xx (version 580.178.04-1.1) in the official Omarchy package repository. NVIDIA makes it. Project site: https://www.nvidia.com/.
